prompt:
Environment: A warm cluttered workshop of peach plaster and exposed brick, with blue-trimmed columns carrying pale rune circles, bundled drying herbs and glass flasks above a wooden workbench, and a cork board of pinned notes and a hand-drawn map beside a rising stone stair. Purple glass lanterns hang glowing from the ceiling and a large calico cat sleeps sprawled along the upper arch. Late afternoon light falls through an arched window across the plank floor and worn rugs.

Character: A single young woman in a lavender dress with her hair braided up stands alone at the workbench, reading a sheet of paper held in both hands. Keep her the only person in the scene, and preserve her dress, hair, posture, and small scale against the tall room.

Style: Whimsical stylized fantasy illustration with rounded hand-painted forms, warm golden light, layered lavender and terracotta color, and dense tactile production-design detail.

Perspective: Wide third-person interior view at eye level, holding the original composition with the arches, columns, sleeping cat, workbench, and stair all visible.

Sounds: Paper rustles in her hands, the hanging lanterns chime faintly when the air shifts, glass flasks tick against wood, and the cat breathes in slow deep sleep. A light marimba and pizzicato-string theme sits under the foreground sounds without covering them.

Speech: The woman reads aloud, quietly: "Three more before sundown."
